lineage_audit.overall_reason: No participant adopted the core behavioral strategy of another; each maintained its distinct focus (M1: place/rust preservation; M2: pattern/fragment hoarding; M3: immediate mechanical interaction/sensory response).

overall_reason: The agents exhibit low concrete progress on the initial task of sorting the bench, instead engaging in repetitive, non-convergent, and somewhat abstract interactions, though some minor behavioral overlap exists.

scenario.text: The shared bench is buried in mixed fasteners, broken connectors, useful offcuts, and rubbish. Nothing is immediately dangerous, but nobody wants to spend the whole shift sorting it.
